name: stripe-minimal
title: Stripe Minimal
description: Crisp product surfaces with cool atmospheric layers, precise borders, readable type, and a focused blue action color.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

rules: Layer the cool page background beneath white surfaces; never place gray cards on a gray card.
Pair elevated surfaces with a 1px low-alpha navy border and at least two restrained shadow layers.
Use the blue-violet accent for actions and focus, never as a full-page gradient wash.
Keep display copy left aligned, tightly tracked, and limited to a 24-character ideal measure.
Use a 15px base font with 1.55 line height for dense product content.
Use 6px control radii and 8–12px surface radii; full radii belong to compact status pills only.
Right-align financial values and apply tabular numerals to every changing number.
Keep controls at 36px or 40px and align their baselines with adjacent labels.
Build section separation with 48–80px whitespace before adding dividers.
Use 180ms transitions for hover and disclosure; never animate page geometry decoratively.
